verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an official CLI: `npx auth init` appears on the homepage, CLI docs live at /docs/concepts/cli, and the device-authorization docs reference the Better Auth CLI. Community users confirm hands-on use of the CLI to generate database tables and set up auth with one command. missing for 10: an evidenced command reference beyond init and schema generation, and AI/agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive agent workflows.
